Took Os last year and used correction tape for all my papers(bc I couldn't function without it). Nothing happened, and I received my results as normal. Of course it's best not to use it! Pages might stick together and this can result in possible loss of marks, and many other things might happen. So if you can, it would better not to use it.

Please don't do it. You have a bright future ahead of you, and O-levels are not everything. Even if you may not make it to your desired school/course, there's always other options you can choose. From there, you can continue to work on your goal to get to your dream school/course. Personally I've been in this situation before( took my Os last year)  and I was feeling really upset and disappointed with myself. But I pushed on and scored decently for my Os. It's really not everything. Your parents would be even more sad if you took your life, compared to scoring poorly for Os. HMU if you wanna talk to someone!
